note: 50-match league composition is the deterministic result of the frozen selection rule: PL 16, La Liga 13, Ligue 1 12, Bundesliga 7, Serie A 2. The earlier 17/13/12/5/3 composition was an incorrect prior estimate and was not used to alter the sample.
selection_rule: season_id IN (2025/26) AND status='FT' ORDER BY unix ASC, fixture_id ASC LIMIT 50

promotion.note: Validation only. V4 is NOT promoted.
